capabilities.text: Start from a shape already built from pieces
Click a straight side on the figure to add a rectangle onto it
capabilities.evidence: handle:click:add a rectangle on this side

capabilities.text: Add a triangle, semicircle or other piece onto a straight side
capabilities.note: Only by typing the piece and its coordinates in the spec; the click handle adds rectangles only. Checked by hand: the triangle sits on the top side.

capabilities.text: Pieces to use: rectangle, triangle, semicircle, circle
capabilities.note: As starting presets and as spec pieces; there is no palette to click from.

capabilities.text: Drag a piece's side on the figure to resize it
capabilities.note: From the page controls, not the bullets. Seen on the live page: select a piece and drag the handles on its sides. Ours drags a corner (linked points follow), which resizes the piece the same way.

capabilities.text: Click a piece on the figure to type its exact sizes
capabilities.note: From the page controls, not the bullets. Seen on the live page: a selected rectangle opens Width and Height boxes.

capabilities.text: Click a piece on the figure to delete it
capabilities.note: From the page controls, not the bullets. Seen on the live page: the piece's pop-up has Delete.

capabilities.text: Click a piece on the figure to shade it
capabilities.note: From the page controls, not the bullets. Seen on the live page: the piece's pop-up has Shading.

capabilities.text: Drag from a corner or the middle of a side to draw a line, such as a height
capabilities.note: From the page controls, not the bullets. Seen on the live page: the Lines mode, 'draw heights and other lines'.

capabilities.text: Click a side on the figure to label it with its length or text
capabilities.note: From the page controls, not the bullets. Seen on the live page: Label mode, a side's pop-up has Label None/Measure/Text.

capabilities.text: Click a side on the figure to give it congruence ticks, parallel arrows or a line style
capabilities.note: From the page controls, not the bullets. Seen on the live page: the side's pop-up has Congruence ticks, Parallel arrows, Line and Thickness.

capabilities.text: Click an angle on the figure to label it, mark it right or shade it
capabilities.note: From the page controls, not the bullets. Seen on the live page: Label mode, an angle's pop-up has Label, Right-angle mark and Shading.

capabilities.text: Click a corner on the figure to show a named point there
capabilities.note: From the page controls, not the bullets. Seen on the live page: Label mode, a corner's pop-up has Point.
